original.statement: The CLI flag `--endpoint-status` has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.

decision.reason: [ev-f64f7c540c6d] lists "The flag `endpoint-status` has been removed" under 1.16 Upgrade Notes › Removed Options. That makes it a cli-flag subject. The family convention adds the leading "--", which gives --endpoint-status. The text names no specific component, so none is set. The change type is "removed". The validators were inconclusive because the chart was unavailable, so they neither confirm nor contradict this.
